items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: I know this other fella, Dan, Dan, Dandy, he used to play bass with Frank Ducey

ctx.x: Zeb was playing clarinet, and, uh, this here, a fellow here, was playing, uh, he was playing, uh, didn't I mention, uh, Punch, was playing, and Punch would take a whole band by himself, no other trumpet, no other trumpet, he'd take it by himself, but the trumpet don't come, he, he, he, he got him, and take it all by himself, and he hold it down, he got a heavy lift, he got a strong lift, was he as powerful as your brother? oh, well, I tell you, I, well, I believe Punch, had a better lift than my brother, yeah, my…
